tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gzungs bklag thabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsams pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor bsgoms pa'i nang du bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad mnan pa'i padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi shes pa oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi gsang sngags kyi yi ge'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa dang*/ lhan cig 'dus shing ro gcig tu gyur pa las byung ba'i rang nyid gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can/ sku mdog dkar mo zhabs g.yas pa cung zad brkyangs nas bsgyings pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ zhi ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ khro ba la sogs pa'i nyams du ma dang ldan zhing kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dbu stong mnga' ba/ skyabs sbyin dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang*/ mchog sbyin pa dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur dang*/ sdigs mdzub la sogs pa'i phyag rgya sna tshogs bcas shing*/ rdo rje dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ nor bu dang*/ padma dang*/ ral gri dang*/ mda' dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ tho ba dang*/ zhags pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan du ma 'dzin pa'i phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ sku'i cha thams cad la 'dzum pa dang*/ zur gyis lta ba dang*/ rnam par bgrad pa dang*/ glog ltar 'khyug pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/

rdo rje'i rang bzhin ltar mi phyed pa'i sku dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing*/ kun tu mched pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo la khro bo dang khro mo du ma'i sprul pa'i tshogs 'phros pas bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs 'joms shing*/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub du ma stsol ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma can ma/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i mthu thogs pa med cing yangs pa chen pos sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang skur zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis rim gror byed pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad kyis mchod cing rjes la/ bka' rjes su bsgrub pa'i phyir yongs su bskor ba bsam par bya'o// 'bring la dga' bas ni/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa bsgom par bya ste/ sku mdog dang rtsa ba'i zhal dkar zhing*/ 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ zhal g.yas sngo zhing khro la g.yon zhal dmar zhing 'dzum pa/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje dang*/ mda' dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ gzhu bsnams pa bsgom mo// bsdus pa la dga' bas ni/ phyag gnyis ma/ sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yon pas bdag nyid yul 'khor srid 'bangs dang bcas pa khebs pa'i gdugs dkar po bsnams pa/ nyams dang cha lugs thams cad snga ma ltar bsgom par bya'o// de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab cing*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug byas nas/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ dbang gi chus lus thams cad gang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang nus pa mnyam par byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du oṃ bsgoms pa'i khor yug tu sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor ba'i 'od kyis 'phags pa mchod/ phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par du gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad par bsam zhing sngags bzla ste/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ kha sa me/ kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ sarba buddha a dhiṣṭhā na/ a dhiṣṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla'o// 'di la bsnyen pa song ba dang*/ las kyi sngags ni gzungs ring nyid yin te/ de zlo bar 'dod pas rang gi sku'i cha nas 'phros pa'i mtshon cha du ma thogs pa'i khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas pha rol gyi rig sngags kyi zhags pa bcad nas sngags sbyor ba po dang*/ zlo ba po phur bus btab pa dang mnan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sitwā ta pa la sogs pa'i sngags ci nus su bzla'o// bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar phyung ba la mchod cing bstod nas bzod par gsol te/ badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol la/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// bum pa'i cho ga byed pa na/ padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bca' thabs gzhan dang 'dra bar byas la/ de'i nang du bdag bskyed ltar cho ga rgyas par byas te/ bzlas pa byas pas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsam/ mchod bstod bkra shis la sogs pa byas te/ longs spyod na/ yams nad la sogs pa 'di nyid kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i gnod pa rnams las rgyal bar 'gyur ro// 'di'i gtor ma ni/ dkar gtor dang dmar gtor gnyis bshams nas sngags drug phyag rgya drug gam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i byin gyis brlabs nas/

rtags par 'di dpe gcig las 'byung yang phyi mo gzhan rnams nas ma byung*/ bsams la/ bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang bcas pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa dkar gsum la dga' ba rnams la dkar gtor dang*/ sha khrag la dga' ba rnams la dmar gtor 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ sngags ring gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bzla'o// gleng gzhi dang bcas pa'i gzungs rgyas par 'don par 'dod na/ 'di nyid kyi skabs su 'don par bya ste/ bdag gis gzungs bton pa'i tshe gtor ma'i mgron bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas ji skad brjod pa'i don bsgrub par bsam zhing 'don par bya'o// mthar mchod cing bstod la bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol lo// cho ga rgyas pa las kyi tshogs dang bcas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o// rje btsun ba ri lo tsā ba las brgyud pa/ rje sa skya pa'i man ngag gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi sgom thabs dang bklag pa'i thabs/ shing phag khra zla'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin par 'phags pa'i tre'i sa char bsdebs pa'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor las// rab sprul phyir zlog chen mo'i sku// gzhan gyis mi thub la btud nas/ de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya// skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i dbus su/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad 'og tu mnan pa'i pad nyi'i gdan la rang sems gdugs dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas gdugs dkar can gyi sngags kyi yig 'bru dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog dkar mo/

dbu'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang bcas pa/ dbus dkar g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba'i zhal gsum la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje mda' lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub zhags pa gzhu/ lhag ma nyams sna tshogs can gyi dbu stong mnga' ba/ phyag rgya ma nges pa sna tshogs pas rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ nor bu/ padma/ ral gri/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ gzhu/ tho ba/ zhags pa la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'i phyag stong*/ sku lus kyi cha thams cad du khyab pa/ rnam 'gyur ma nges pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong can/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// pho nya dang pho nya mo dang mchod pa'i sprin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang skur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rim gro byed pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis mchod cing bstod la bka' sgrub pa'i sku can du gyur/ 'bring du na rtsa ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug tsam du gsal btab kyang rung*/ shin tu bsdu na skyabs sbyin dang gdugs dkar po can bsgom/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam ye gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes snying po nyid gang 'grub bzla'o// mthar ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ phyir zlog chen mo rig sngags rgyal// gzhan gyis mi thub stobs chen ma// gdugs dkar chen mo sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas bstod// ces bstod/ bzod par gsol zhing*/ badzra muḥzhes gshegs su gsol/ 'di la 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma ni mi dgos so// byed par spro na/

dkar gtor a kā ros 'bul/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtsang ma'i zas sna sna tshogs btab pa'i dkar gtor zhig dang*/ sha chang sgog btsong sogs sna tshogs kyis sbags pa'i dmar gtor zhig bsham/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gi byin gyis brlab/ a kā ro lan bdun bdun gyis gtsang rigs rnams dang*/ 'byung po rnams la sbyin/ de nas cha gsum gtor ma'ang gtong ngo*// thun mtshams su bris sku'i mdun du gzungs mdo ci nus su 'don pa'am klog go /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga nyid sbyar bar bya'o// rig sngags kun 'dus phyir zlog pa// phun tshogs kun gyi dga' skyed 'di// gdugs dkar sgrub thabs rgya mtsho yi// snying por mkhas rnams nges shes bskyed// gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi sgrub thabs kyi le'u tshan no// ༈ /gdugs dkar 'don thabs sangs rgyas rnal 'byor du byed pa'i man ngag thar lo'i lam srung ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gsum/ rang dang bsrung bya'i spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng*// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med lhag pa'i lha// gdugs dkar can ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi// g.yas pa skyabs sbyin g.yon pas gdugs 'khor lo// rab dkar rdo rje rtse lnga'i tog 'od 'phro// gser gyi yu bar brten pa'i mdzes tshul can// rin chen rgyan spras rdo rje skyil krung gis// bzhugs pa'i steng gi mkha' la rim pa bzhin// ston pa mnyam med shākya thub pa la// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis yongs su bskor// de 'og yi dam rgyud sde bzhi po'i lha// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rnam pa dpal gyis mdzes// de 'og sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun sogs// de bzhin gshegs pa sprul sku'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs// de 'og nye sras brgyad sogs byang sems dang*// mtha' mar nyan rang gtso mo'i steng du bzhugs// rang mdun sa la legs ldan mched gsum po// dbus su grong khyer gsum 'jig de'i g.yas su// dka' thub zlog dang g.yon du sred med bu// bdag la dgyes shing srung ba'i tshul du 'khod// de yi phyi rol phyogs skyong rgyal chen dang*// drug cu rtsa bzhi'i pho nya mo tshogs bskor// de'i mthar zas su za ba'i gdon bgegs dang*// 'byung po'i rigs rnams mngon sum 'khod par gyur// ces brjod cing gsal gdab/

skyabs yul bka' sdod dang bcas pa la 'dod don zhu zhing 'byung po rnams la bka' bsgo ba'i tshul du gdugs dkar gyi gzungs mdo tshar gsum sogs brjod pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyis myong bar nges pa'i las nyon bag chags byad byur rmi lam ngan pa thams cad phyir bud pa bgegs rnams kyis zos par bsam/ yang 'od zer des bka' sdod rnams bskul bas phrin las bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes/ bgegs dang 'byung po rnams kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi nas rang la gnod 'tshe mi byed cing*/ mthun rkyen bsgrub par khas blang*/ gang gis kyang zhi bar mi nus pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad de dag gis blangs te rdul du brlag par bsams bzlog pa bya/ mthar/ thub dbang bla mar bcas pa rigs lngar thim// de yang sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang la// rim gyis thim zhu bcom ldan 'das mar bsdu// gtso mo 'od zhu rang la thim pa las// rang lus rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa// lte bar sems nyid hūm̐ yig mtshan ma can// gsal bas gdon bgegs tshogs rnams so sor deng*// srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par gyur// ces brjod la spyod lam gyis gnas par bya'o// dbus 'gyur tshal du bho ṭa'i btsun gcig pur// grags pa'i rnga gsang mtho ba 'jig rten mig /thar pa lo tsā nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi// gdams pa zab mo bu ston yab sras las// brgyud pa'i yid ches ldan nor gab rgya'i gnad// sba sri med par tshigs su bcad bsdebs pa'i// dge bas 'gro kun gdugs dkar can ma yi// thugs rje'i grib bsil stug pos bsrung gyur cig /ces gtsug tor gdugs dkar 'don thabs sam sangs rgyas rnal 'byor du byed pa'i man ngag thal lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan nas bu ston yab sras la brgyud nas byung ba'i dmigs rim yi ger bkod pa 'di ni/ kun mkhyen bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bka' lung padma rā ga'i phreng ba spyi bos mchod nas btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong gis dpal zha lu ri phug tu bris pa'o// zhal dro// sarba maṅgalaṃ//

༈ /bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i gzungs mdo'i mjug tu zlog sgyur bya ba'i tshul bzhugs so// bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs rnams// mthu stobs thogs pa mi mnga' zhing*// thugs rje smon lam mthu btsan pas// bdag gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// chag che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol// rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog /dgra 'dre'i bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi zlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog /yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog /mas kyi sri ru langs pa zlog /dpral ba'i gshed du bskos pa zlog /pha mes dur sri langs pa zlog /mi la nad du gtong ba zlog /phyugs la god kha byed pa zlog /gnam gyi dal kha thebs pa zlog /sa yi dug mda' g.yos pa zlog /sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog /skegs dang phung sri langs pa bzlog tu gsol// zhes gtsug tor gdugs dkar la brten pa'i zlog pa grub chen las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'o// bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed tshar gcod nas// bde legs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// bde mchog gdugs dkar can gyi bkra shis shog /sarba dā maṅgalaṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
